name: The First Emperor
summary: The wind stopped. Then something fell out of the sky.

steps.journal: The wind stopped dead. Falcon went pale and told me to get behind him. Something was falling out of the sky, straight at the lookout.

Alpha, one of the seven Emperors. Small enough to be mistaken for a child, until you feel the air around her. Her blast threw Falcon and me off the mountain, and the rockfall walled us in. Nothing I do even scratches her.
